sections.title: When you're lost in a conversation
sections.content: *Még egyszer, kérem* asks for something to be repeated ("once more, please"); *lassabban* asks for it more slowly. *Megismételnéd?* ("could you repeat that?") and *mit mondtál?* ("what did you say?") do the same job in slightly different words — using the informal *te* you've been using since Unit 1.

Chain these together and you'll rarely be stuck: *Nem értem. Még egyszer, kérem* — "I don't understand. Once more, please" — is a complete, natural, and extremely useful two-sentence rescue for any conversation that's gotten away from you.
